Identifies if the segment is part of one of the following county plans:
KC Regional Trails System

Many of these regional trails also fall under both local and county plans (and both will be
labeled). The regional trails that are completed have only the county attribute filled in.

Identifies if a local or county plan recommends a particular facility type
All facility types are from PSRC’s Regional Bike Facility Typology. Many jurisdictions have their
own labels, but were changed to reflect PSRC’s classifications.

Identifies if a segment is completed. NOTE: PSRC’s most recent comprehensive review of
completed segments concluded at the beginning of 2012. Newer facilities may not be shown
yet as completed.
Completed segments in this data set are those with bike lanes, shared use paths, protected
bicycle lanes, neighborhood greenways and in few instances and if for a short distance, a
marked shared lane or paved and striped shoulder as per BPAC recommendation.

Cascade Bicycle Club (CBC) ‘Left by the Side of the Road’ – this attribute shows how the
Regional Bicycle Network is consistent with the CBC network.

Identifies the length of a segment. A ‘segment’ is any portion of the bicycle network between
two intersecting segments of the bike network.
